correctness.rationale: Full frozen proof independently checked. Under the assumed nonempty counterexample class, choose |I| above any specified cardinal and |A|. Coordinate units inject I into c0(I), and A direct-sum c0(I) remains in the class by the source closure assumption. Its cardinal is strictly larger, so a reverse direct-sum decomposition is impossible. This satisfies both order conditions and yields a strict successor. Every set of representatives has a cardinal upper bound, contradicted by the same construction. Ordinary set-valued Zorn therefore cannot justify the announced unrestricted maximal element. The full primary Proposition 1, including closure, both order conditions, chain proof and final enlargement, has now been read and matches the target. This does not disprove the amenability implication or produce a counterexample to it.
